audience: automotive repair shop teams using Shop Boss for service and inventory work

useCases.title: Prepare for a customer visit
useCases.text: Find the customer, review their vehicles and read associated repair orders to understand the work before the visit.

useCases.title: Review the appointment schedule
useCases.text: Review scheduled appointment dates alongside service bays and shop hours to prepare for the day.

useCases.title: Check parts for a repair order
useCases.text: Review the parts and quantities on a repair order, then look up inventory availability and supplier details.

useCases.title: Prepare a recommended-work follow-up
useCases.text: Review recommended or previously declined repairs for a customer or vehicle and consult predefined services before drafting a follow-up.
